attBesluta.text: Had to replace a broken one of same size and this fit the bill at a better price than the original one.
Excellent quality and perfect size for the half bath vanity, fast shipping and as soon as we got that one i ordered 2 more slightly bigger for the main bathroom vanity.

We love our new Vevor sinks!! We had 3 of them installed in our bathrooms and are very happy with the appearance, the shape and the size.

This sink doesn't come with a cutout template, additionally, its drain hole is irregularly shaped, (non-circular) which means we'll have to be more creative with our drain assembly. These 2 notations are the only reason we are not offering 5 stars. This is a well built sink that arrived without damage - the vendor took great care with the packaging to ensure this.
Good value set, only learning and this is perfect, super fast delivery

The set vame incomplete. The extra carbide replacement cutters are missing. The tools seem okay and should work well on small projects. The handles are a bit too small. I think that these tools would work better with a larger and heavier handles. For the price, I think this is I a good entry level carbide woodturning set.
Excellent. Top quality. Will definitely be buying more.

Been playing a few times a week for about 6 months and just wanted a stick that’s consistent and this is GREATT. I GOT THE 21oz fiberglass and it’s smooth shooting and the tip is actually good quality and gets good grip.

These are an amazing set of adjustable tracks for a great price. They are strong and provide a lot of support with the dual tracks. They are also nice for splicing a shelf over a support vs in the middle making it weak. I installed them in the pantry and realized later that this was overkill for that space. They created ton of storage capacity, but probably would have done better in the garage for heavier objects. They install in minutes right to the studs or you can use wall anchors between studs. I would recommend to anyone wanting to add wall storage.
These worked great with similar style shelf brackets we had bought at a local box store. No compatibility issues.

It's hard to rate something that just "is" rather than turning on and off or moving. The wall standards worked just fine, they didn't fall off the walls, even when they were loaded with hundreds of pounds of wood. The slots accepted the shelf brackets without complaint. My only small issue was that there were five more holes than screws.
